content.title: Hell’s Paradise Season 2 Episode 12 Release Date, Time, Where to Watch
content.text: The release date and time for Hell’s Paradise Season 2, Episode 12 are right around the corner, and fans are eagerly anticipating the details on where and when they can catch this highly awaited anime series. In the previous episode, titled “Ephemeralness and Fire,” it showcases how Gabimaru recalls the days he spent with Yui. But the question is asked about how his battle against Rien will end.Below, you will find all the essential information regarding the release date and time for Hell’s Paradise Season 2 Episode 11, as well as details on how and when to stream it online.When is the Hell’s Paradise Season 2 Episode 12 release date & time?The episode’s release date is Sunday, March 29, 2026, and its release time is 7:15 a.m. PT and 10:15 a.m. ET.Check out its release times in the U.S. below:TimezoneRelease DateRelease TimeEastern TimeMarch 29, 202610:15 a.m.Pacific TimeMarch 29, 20267:15 a.m.Where to watch Hell’s Paradise Season 2 Episode 12You can watch Hell’s Paradise Season 2 Episode 12 via Crunchyroll.Crunchyroll has established itself as a leading platform, providing a vast array of series, films, and nearly instantaneous simulcasts from Japan. Beyond streaming, the service offers manga reading and the latest anime news, making it a comprehensive resource for enthusiasts. Available globally, Crunchyroll offers free access supported by ads, as well as premium subscription options.What is Hell’s Paradise about?The official synopsis for Hell’s Paradise is as follows:“For a chance at a pardon, a ninja assassin joins other condemned criminals on a journey to a mysterious island to retrieve an elixir of immortality.”
